description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Raydar is recruiting for a software company serving service businesses. The Forward Deployed Engineer will build and deploy AI agents for enterprise customers, own implementation and ongoing technical customer relationships, and translate customer feedback into product improvements.
Customer-facing AI agent engineer delivering enterprise implementations and translating customer needs into product improvements

Responsibilities:
• Develop voice, text, and phone-based AI agents for enterprise customers
• Own implementation, onboarding, and ongoing technical customer relationships
• Translate customer problems into product and platform improvements
• Coordinate with engineering and design to deliver production solutions
• Support account adoption and expansion through effective technical delivery

Requirements:
• 1 to 5 years as a forward deployed or customer-facing software engineer
• Experience shipping production code for customers
• Strong Python and SQL, REST API skills, and familiarity with React, TypeScript, and Node.js
• A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related STEM field
• Ability to present to executives and work across technical and customer-success responsibilities
• Comfort with startup pace and changing priorities

Preferred:
• Experience as a founder or founding engineer
• Interest in AI for home services, construction, or remodeling
